questions.q: Ildefonso P. Santos Jr. is officially recognized as the 'Father' of which specific design profession in the Philippines?
questions.n: He pioneered the professional practice of landscape architecture in the country, elevating it to a recognized academic and professional field.

questions.q: Which major public park in Manila did IP Santos famously redesign, adding modern features like the Dancing Fountain and the Open Air Theater?
questions.n: His redesign of Luneta in the 1960s transformed it into a world-class public space, integrating modern amenities with historical monuments.

questions.q: IP Santos designed the landscapes for the Cultural Center of the Philippines (CCP) complex. How did his design complement Leandro Locsin's 'floating' building?
o: By building a theme park next to the theater
By planting dense forests to hide the concrete
By using expansive lagoons and manicured lawns to enhance the building's reflection and scale
By surrounding it with high concrete walls for security
questions.n: The water and open greenery serve as a 'pedestal' for the massive structure, emphasizing its weightless appearance.

questions.q: In his resort projects like Tagaytay Highlands, IP Santos was known for using 'Hardscapes' that harmonized with the environment. What does 'hardscape' refer to in landscape architecture?
o: The roof of the main building
The soil quality of the site
Non-living elements such as pathways, walls, and fountains
questions.n: Hardscape includes the structural elements of a garden that provide form, movement, and organization to the outdoor space.

questions.q: True or False: Ildefonso Santos Jr. was conferred the title of National Artist for Architecture in 2006.
questions.n: He was the first landscape architect to receive this honor, recognizing his unique contribution to the Philippine built environment.
